ideas.pitch: A vernacular voice-first AI assistant designed for rural healthcare workers to track local immunization schedules, report waterborne disease outbreaks, and log maternal health metrics via simple phone calls or WhatsApp audio messages.
ideas.title: GramSwasthya
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the rural India community challenge mandate of the hackathon with a working multilingual demo, closely mirroring past winners focused on health awareness and accessibility.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first progressive web app connecting rural farmer producer organizations directly with urban micro-retailers, cutting out middlemen and predicting optimal perishable produce pricing using lightweight regression.
ideas.title: AgriLink Supply Chain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines both rural production and urban consumption challenges into a single scalable economic solution with clear measurable impact on farmer margins.

ideas.pitch: A real-time voice call analyzer extension that detects fraudulent financial schemes and loan scams targeting elderly or semi-urban citizens in regional Indian languages.
ideas.title: Sahayak AI Scams Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies real-time AI safety engineering to a severe domestic problem, matching the technical sophistication of previous agentic safety winners.

ideas.pitch: An automated urban infrastructure reporting tool that ingests dashcam or smartphone video from delivery riders, detects potholes and streetlamp failures using edge computer vision, and auto-routes tickets to municipal dashboards.
ideas.title: CivicPothole AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a prominent urban community challenge with a live working demo that maps issues directly for city officials, reflecting successful civic tech winning patterns.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered matchmaking platform that pairs urban volunteer youth with nearby rural skill-development centers and adult literacy initiatives based on real-time availability and proximity.
ideas.title: SevaConnect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear social community impact by bridging urban resources with rural educational deficits within a tightly scoped 24-hour build.
